column5: ('DES PORTEFEUILLES MAGIQUES TUENT DES ÉLÈVES AU TOGO Dans la ville de Kpalimé située au sud-ouest du Togo🇹🇬, dans la région des Plateaux, à 128 km de la capitale Lomé se déroule actuellement une histoire des plus macabres. De jeunes élèves, une quinzaine, à la recherche de l’argent facile se sont attachés, entre novembre et décembre, les services d’un marabout venu du Bénin dans le but d’obtenir de « l’argent sans effort » en vu des fêtes de fin d’année. D’après les faits relatés, ces jeunes élèves ont eu ce qu’ils voulaient, de l’argent et à gogo. Mais ce n’était pas sans contrepartie. L’argent (100.000 FCFA) qui leur venait mystiquement sur leur compte mobile money ou dans leur porte-monnaie chaque jour, devait être dépensé en totalité le même jour et toutes réalisations (Maison construite par exemple, ou quelconque héritage) devait leur servir à eux seuls. Les membres de leurs familles ne pouvant en aucun cas en bénéficier. Mais les choses se corsent lorsqu’il s’est agit d’effectuer des sacrifices humains pour continuer à bénéficier de cet « argent facile ». Dans l’incapacité de continuer par exécuter les demandes du marabout, certains ont perdu la vie. Au total cinq personnes sont déjà mortes et parmi ces cinq, l’un a eu le courage d’avouer les faits à un prêtre avant de rendre l’âme. À l’heure où nous écrivons ces mots dix autres sont dans un état critique à l’hôpital de Kpalimé et nul ne sait s’ils s’en sortiront ou s’ils rejoindront leurs compères dans l’au-delà. Cette histoire fait froid dans le dos mais il faut que la jeunesse retienne qu’il faut se battre dans la vie pour réussir plutôt que de chasser l’argent facile car il n’y a qu’une seule fin derrière cette course, y laisser la vie. Si vous êtes tentés de suivre la voie de ces jeunes pour vous enrichir, vous savez ce qui vous attend à la fin. Nous vous quittons avec cette phrase du rappeur Ninho : «Il n’y a rien de facile dans le gain facile».', 'MAGIC WALLETS KILL STUDENTS IN TOGO In the city of Kpalimé located in the south-west of Togo🇹🇬, in the Plateaux region, 128 km from the capital Lomé, a most macabre story is currently unfolding. Fifteen young students looking for easy money engaged the services of a marabout from Benin between November and December with the aim of obtaining "effortless money" in view of the Christmas and New Year. From the facts recounted, these young students got what they wanted, money and galore. But it was not without consideration. The money (100,000 FCFA) that mystically came to them on their mobile money account or in their wallet every day, had to be spent in full on the same day and all achievements (House built for example, or any inheritance) had to be used for their them alone. The members of their families cannot benefit from it in any case. But things get tough when it comes to making human sacrifices to continue to benefit from this "easy money". Unable to continue to carry out the demands of the marabout, some lost their lives. A total of five people have already died and among these five, one had the courage to confess the facts to a priest before dying. At the time of writing, ten others are in critical condition at Kpalimé hospital and no one knows if they will make it or join their friends in the afterlife. This story sends shivers down the spine but young people must remember that they have to fight in life to succeed rather than chasing easy money because there is only one end behind this race, to leave life. If you are tempted to follow the path of these young people to get rich, you know what awaits you in the end. We leave you with this sentence from rapper Ninho: "There is nothing easy about easy gain".', [('fra', 1.0)])

column3: [('www CLADORADON GENOMTARVES IT DEA DE 2003 LO CONFIRMO AYER LA ORGANIZACION MUNDIAL DE LA SALUD Un virus nunca visto en humanos provoca la neumonía atípica ►Es un coronavirus mutante cuya existencia era, hasta hace poco, desconocida. Según el virólogo japonés Masato Tashiro, quien participó en el trabajo, "este virus ha esta- do durante mucho tiempo en la naturale- za pero desconociamos su existencia". column5: ('#ENELMUNDO NIPAH, EL NUEVO VIRUS QUE SE EXPANDE POR ASIA Y PODRÍA CONVERTIRSE EN PANDEMIA Según la OMS, es uno de las de los diez patógenos más peligrosos. La enfermedad se transmite a través de los fluidos como la saliva y la sangre y no existe vacuna. Al tiempo que crecen los casos de coronavirus en el mundo y existen pocas certezas acerca de cuándo llegará a su fin, el Centro de Ciencias de la Salud y Enfermedades Infecciosas Emergentes de la Cruz Roja Tailandesa advirtió sobre el desarrollo de un nuevo virus y su posible propagación a lo largo del planeta. Se trata del virus del Nipah, el cual nace en las regiones tropicales que tienen una rica variedad de biodiversidad, lo que significa que también albergan una gran cantidad de patógenos. Esto aumenta las posibilidades de que surja un nuevo virus. Según la Organización Mundial de la Salud (OMS), es uno de las de los diez patógenos más peligrosos en términos de potencial epidémico. En Asia ya se experimentaron varios brotes de esta enfermedad. Alguien con el virus Nipah puede tener síntomas respiratorios que incluyen tos, dolor de garganta, dolores y fatiga, y encefalitis, una inflamación del cerebro que puede causar convulsiones y la muerte. El último brote sucedió en Kerala, India en 2018 cuando mató a 17 personas de un total de 19 infectadas –una tasa de mortalidad de 89%–. En esa oportunidad, la ciudad atendió la crisis y envió expertos en el manejo del ébola para poner en práctica los protocolos necesarios para evitar su propagación. Supaporn Wacharapluesadee dirige el Centro de Ciencias de la Salud y Enfermedades Infecciosas Emergentes de la Cruz Roja Tailandesa en Bangkok. En la última década formó parte de Predict, una iniciativa mundial para detectar y detener enfermedades que pueden pasar de animales a humanos. Junto a su equipo tomaron muestras a muchas especies, pero su enfoque principal estuvo en los murciélagos, que se sabe que albergan muchos coronavirus. Pudieron comprender la enfermedad en solo unos días, detectando el primer caso de Covid-19 fuera de China. El crecimiento de las poblaciones humanas y el aumento del contacto entre personas y animales salvajes también aumentan el factor de riesgo. En el transcurso de un proyecto en el que tomó muestras de miles de murciélagos, se descubrieron muchos virus nuevos. Entre estos está el Nipah. Los murciélagos que comen fruta son su huésped natural. "Supone una gran preocupación porque no hay tratamiento y este virus tiene una alta tasa de mortalidad", comentó Wacharapluesadee. Según la experta citada por la BBC, hay varias razones por las que el virus Nipah sea tan siniestro. El largo período de incubación de la enfermedad, que puede llegar hasta los 45 días, significa que existen muchas posibilidades de que un animal o persona infectada, sin saber que está enferma, lo propague. Además puede infectar a una amplia gama de animales, lo que aumenta la posibilidad de que se extienda. Y se puede contagiar por contacto directo o consumiendo alimentos contaminados.', '#IN THE WORLD NIPAH, THE NEW VIRUS THAT IS SPREADING THROUGH ASIA AND COULD BECOME A PANDEMIC According to the WHO, it is one of the ten most dangerous pathogens. The disease is transmitted through fluids such as saliva and blood and there is no vaccine. As coronavirus cases grow around the world and there is little certainty about when it will come to an end, the Thai Red Cross Center for Health Sciences and Emerging Infectious Diseases has warned of the development of a new virus and its possible spread across the planet. column5: ('El profesor João Alberto Guimarães, brasileño en un intercambio con Europa, entró en una estación del metro de Estocolmo, capital de Suecia. Entonces le preguntó a la vendedora de tiquetes el porqué de aquel torniquete, permanentemente libre para pasar y sin ningún agente de seguridad en las cercanías. La dama, entonces, le explicó ese paso estaba destinado a las personas que, por cualquier motivo, no tuviesen dinero para pagar su pasaje. La vendedora entrecerró sus límpidos ojos azules y con una sonrisa de pureza sobrecogedora, le respondió: - Pero porqué harían eso? Sin poder acertar una respuesta, el profe pagó su pasaje y pasó por el torniquete, seguido de una multitud que tambiém habia pagado por sus tiquetes. El paso libre continuó vacío. La honestidad es uno de los valores más liberadores que un pueblo puede tener. Una sociedad que ha logrado transformar ese valor en algo natural, está en un estadio de desarrollo, sin duda, superior. The saleswoman narrowed her limpid blue eyes and with a smile of overwhelming purity, she replied: - But why would they do that? Unable to get an answer right, the teacher paid his ticket and went through the turnstile, followed by a crowd that had also paid for their tickets. The free passage remained empty. Honesty is one of the most liberating values that a people can have. A society that has managed to transform this value into something natural is undoubtedly at a higher stage of development. That's education... Also and first of all! Cultivate this value and pass it on even when the same is not likely to be expected from society. Your world changes when you change. A cordial greeting.", [('spa', 1.0)])

column5: ("I never knew ... DID YOU? If any of you have ever been to a military funeral in which taps was played; this brings out a new meaning of it. Here is something Every American should know. Until I read this, I didn't know, but I checked it out and it's true: We in the United States have all heard the haunting song, 'Taps...' It's the song that gives us the lump in our throats and usually tears in our eyes. But, do you know the story behind the song? If not, I think you will be interested to find out about its humble beginnings. Reportedly, it all began in 1862 during the Civil War, when Union Army Captain Robert Elli was with his men near Harrison's Landing in Virginia. The Confederate Army was on the other side of the narrow strip of land. During the night, Captain Elli heard the moans of a soldier who lay severely wounded on the field. Not knowing if it was a Union or Confederate soldier, the Captain decided to risk his life and bring the stricken man back for medical attention. Crawling on his stomach through the gunfire, the Captain reached the stricken soldier and began pulling him toward his encampment.. When the Captain finally reached his own lines, he discovered it was actually a Confederate soldier, but the soldier was dead. The Captain lit a lantern and suddenly caught his breath and went numb with shock. In the dim light, he saw the face of the soldier. It was his own son. The boy had been studying music in the South when the war broke out.. Without telling his father, the boy enlisted in the Confederate Army. The following morning, heartbroken, the father asked permission of his superiors to give his son a full military burial, despite his enemy status. His request was only partially granted. The Captain had asked if he could have a group of Army band members play a funeral dirge for his son at the funeral. The request was turned down since the soldier was a Confederate. But, out of respect for the father, they did say they could give him only one musician. The Captain chose a bugler. He asked the bugler to play a series of musical notes he had found on a piece of paper in the pocket of the dead youth's uniform. This wish was granted. The haunting melody, we now know as 'Taps' used at military funerals was born. The words are: Day is done. Gone the sun. From the lakes From the hills. From the sky. All is well. Safely rest. God is nigh. Fading light. Dims the sight. And a star. Gems the sky. Gleaming bright. From afar. Drawing nigh. Falls the night. Thanks and praise. For our days. Neath the sun Neath the stars. Neath the sky As we go. This we know. God is nigh I too have felt the chills while listening to 'Taps' but I have never seen all the words to the song until now. I didn't even know there was more than one verse . I also never knew the story behind the song and I didn't know if you had either so I thought I'd pass it along. I now have an even deeper respect for the song than I did before. Remember Those Lost and Harmed While Serving Their Country. Also Remember Those Who Have Served And Returned; and for those presently serving in the Armed Forces. Please send this on for our soldiers ... please don't break it. I didn't! 🇺🇸❤️🇺🇸❤️🇺🇸💙🇺🇸💙🇺🇸❤️🇺🇸💙 -\\-\\", "I never knew ... DID YOU? If any of you have ever been to a military funeral in which taps was played; this brings out a new meaning of it. Il s'agit du coefficient d'amplification de l'ADN, du nombre de cycles d'amplification. Le test ne détecte pas des virus entiers en état de marche, mais des morceaux de ce virus actifs ou non. Donc il peut détecter des petits morceaux de virus d'une infection qui date de plusieurs semaines, voir plus. Dans les prélèvements il y a très très peu de morceaux d'ARN viral, donc ils ne peuvent pas être détectés tel quel. Il faut augmenter le nombre de morceaux de manière très importante pour pouvoir les détecter. On transforme cet ARN viral en ADN puis on met un produit qui fait que tous les ADN du prélèvement sont dupliqués de nombreuses fois. On répète plusieurs fois cette opération. Plus on la répète, plus on amplifie leur nombre, plus le CT est grand, plus on risque d'avoir des faux positifs. Moins on la répète, moins on a de faux positifs, mais plus on peut avoir des faux négatifs. Suivant les appareils et les laboratoires on peut aller à des valeurs de Ct plus ou moins grandes de 20 à 45 ! CT = de 20 à 30 => charge virale importante, peu de faux positif, si positif on est certain qu'il y a bien infection à un des 5 coronavirus. Mais risque de faux négatifs CT = 35 => compromis utilisé par l'IHU, quelques faux positifs CT = 40 ou plus => 90% de FAUX positifs = pas de virus COVID, les 10% restant ont une charge virale extrêmement faible, mais il n'y a pas de faux négatifs Les recommandations des scientifiques sont un CT = entre 20 et 30 Dans la pratique des laboratoires d'analyses le plus souvent CT à 40 ou plus ! Si votre test est positif, exigez de connaitre à quel CT ? Ces tests PCR avec CT limité à 25 auraient été très utiles en Février ou Mars 2020 pour isoler les vrais positifs avec une charge virale importante et traitement HCQ+AZT+Zinc. Donc sur le plan médical depuis début juin les PCR n'ont plus aucun intérêt SAUF si on restreint le CT à 30 au maximum. 29 Aout 2020 Docteur Peter EL BAZE Ex Médecin Attaché des Hôpitaux de Nice Ancien Chef du Service de Médecine Interne A1, Les Sources, Nice", 'The great deception of PCR tests 90% of positives are not sick In a PCR test there is a very important factor which is not mentioned in the results is the CT (Threshold Cycle). This is the DNA amplification coefficient, the number of cycles of amplification. The test does not detect whole working viruses, but pieces of this virus active or not. So it can detect small pieces of virus from a infection that dates back several weeks or more. In the samples there are very, very few pieces of viral RNA, so they cannot be detected as is. It is necessary to increase the number of pieces of very important way to be able to detect them. We transform this viral RNA into DNA and then we put a product that makes all the DNA from the sample are duplicated many times. We repeat several times this operation. The more we repeat it, the more we amplify their number, the greater the CT, the more we risk of having false positives. The less we repeat it, the fewer false positives we have, but the more false we can have negatives. Depending on the devices and the laboratories, we can go to Ct values more or smaller from 20 to 45! CT = from 20 to 30 => high viral load, few false positives, if positive we are certain that there is indeed an infection with one of the 5 coronaviruses. But risk of false negatives CT = 35 => compromise used by the IHU, some false positives CT = 40 or more => 90% FALSE positives = no COVID virus, the 10% remaining have an extremely low viral load, but there are no false negatives The recommendations of the scientists are a CT = between 20 and 30 In the practice of analysis laboratories most often CT at 40 or more! If your test is positive, demand to know at which CT? These PCR tests with CT limited to 25 would have been very useful in February or March 2020 to isolate true positives with high viral load and treatment HCQ+AZT+Zinc. So from a medical point of view, since the beginning of June, the PCRs no longer have any interest EXCEPT if we restrict the CT to 30 at most. August 29, 2020 Dr Peter EL BAZE Former Attaché Doctor of the Hospitals of Nice Former Head of the A1 Internal Medicine Department, Les Sources, Nice', [('fra', 0.9841334223747253), ('eng', 0.008812597021460533), ('hun', 0.007053965236991644)])]

column5: ('MALAYSIA MASIH ALPA Ini berlaku di AS... Keputusan yang tidak biasa yang diberikan oleh hakim kepada seorang pencuri kecil... Seorang budak lelaki berusia 15 tahun ditangkap merompak sebuah kedai di Amerika. Untuk cuba melarikan diri, budak lelaki itu juga memusnahkan sebuah rak. Selepas hakim mendengar kes ini, dia bertanya kepada budak lelaki itu: "Adakah anda benar-benar mencuri sesuatu? "Adakah anda mencuri roti dan keju dan memusnahkan rak itu? "" Budak lelaki itu, pemalu, menundukkan kepala, menjawab: "Ya." hakim: "Kenapa awak mencuri? ""Kanak-kanak: "Ia perlu. "" Hakim: "Anda tidak dapat membelinya daripada mencuri mereka? "" Budak lelaki: "Saya tiada duit" Hakim: "Anda boleh meminta wang kepada ibu bapa anda" Budak lelaki: "Saya hanya ada ibu saya yang susah dan sakit dan tiada pekerjaan. "Saya curi roti dan keju untuk dia. "" Hakim: "Kamu tidak melakukan apa-apa, kamu tidak mempunyai pekerjaan? "" Anak: "Saya pernah bekerja di sebuah pencuci kereta. "Saya mengambil cuti untuk membantu ibu saya dan itulah sebabnya saya dipecat. "" Hakim: "Bukankah anda mencari sesuatu yang lain untuk bekerja di tempat lain? "" Selepas perbualan dengan budak lelaki itu tamat, hakim mengumumkan keputusan: Mencuri terutamanya mencuri roti adalah jenayah yang sangat memalukan. Dan di sini kita semua bertanggungjawab atas jenayah ini. Semua orang dalam bilik mahkamah hari ini, termasuk saya, bertanggungjawab atas jenayah ini. Dengan cara ini semua orang di sini akan didenda $10 tiada siapa yang akan keluar dari sini tanpa memberi $10 Hakim mengeluarkan nota $10 dari poketnya, mengambil pen dan mula menulis: Juga, saya mengenakan denda 10,000$ ke atas pemilik kedai kerana menyerahkan kanak-kanak yang kelaparan itu kepada pihak polis. Jika denda tidak dibayar dalam masa sejam, kedai akan kekal ditutup. "" Semua orang di sini meminta maaf kepada budak lelaki itu dan memberikannya $10 kembali. Hakim meninggalkan bilik mahkamah menyembunyikan tangisannya. Selepas mendengar keputusannya, orang di mahkamah menangis di mata mereka. Saya tertanya-tanya jika masyarakat kita, sistem kita, mahkamah kita boleh membuat keputusan sebegitu? Hakim menambah: "Jika seorang ditangkap mencuri roti, semua ahli komuniti, masyarakat dan negara ini patut berasa malu! "" Moral dari cerita benar ini: Budak ini mencuri kerana kemiskinan dan untuk memberi makan kepada ibunya yang sakit tapi " MUNGKIN RAMAI ORANG KAYA" mencuri duit rakyat berbilion ringgit untuk kemewahan dan berpoya-poya. Semoga Allah SWT melindungi kita dan menjauhkan kita daripada sifat mazmumah.', 'MALAYSIA IS STILL ALPA This happened in the US... The unusual verdict given by a judge to a petty thief... A 15-year-old boy was caught robbing a store in America. To try to escape, the boy also destroys a shelf. After the judge heard this case, he asked the boy: "Did you really steal something? "Did you steal the bread and cheese and destroy the shelf? "" The boy, shy, bowed his head, answered: "Yes." judge: "Why did you steal?" "Children: "It was necessary. "" Judge: "You couldn\'t buy them instead of stealing them?" Boy: "I have no money" Judge: "You can ask your parents for money" Boy: "I only have my mother who is poor and sick and has no job. "I steal bread and cheese for her. "" Judge: "You don\'t do anything, you don\'t have a job?" Son: "I used to work at a car wash. "I took time off to help my mom and that\'s why I got fired. "" Judge: "Aren\'t you looking for something else to work on somewhere else?" After the conversation with the boy ended, the judge announced the verdict: Stealing especially stealing bread is a very shameful crime. And here we are all responsible for this crime. Everyone in the courtroom today, including me, is responsible for this crime. This way everyone here will be fined $10 no one will get out of here without giving $10 The judge took a $10 note out of his pocket, picked up a pen and began writing: Also, I fined the store owner $10,000 for handing over the starving child to the police. If the fine is not paid within an hour, the shop will remain closed. "" Everyone here apologized to the boy and gave him $10 back. The judge left the courtroom hiding his tears. After hearing the verdict, people in the court had tears in their eyes. I wonder if our society, our system, our courts can make such a decision? The judge added: "If one person is caught stealing bread, all members of this community, society and country should feel ashamed!" Moral of this true story: This boy stole because of poverty and to feed his sick mother but "MAY MANY RICH PEOPLE" stole billions of ringgits of people\'s money for luxury and indulgence. May Allah SWT protect us and keep us away from the nature of mazmumah.', [('msa', 1.0)])

column5: ('#Trafic_dorganes Chine : plus de 7000 pénis saisies par la douane en provenance du Nigéria Un total de 7 221 pénis d’origine africaine a été saisi par la douane chinoise. Ce serait la plus grande saisie d’organes humains de l’histoire, rapporte hararelive. Les organes, qui étaient cachés dans un conteneur réfrigéré, ont été saisis lorsque le navire a accosté dans le port de Shanghai, à la suite d’informations fournies par un informateur anonyme. Les organes étaient emballés dans 36 cartons étiquetées « bananes plantain » à l’intérieur du conteneur réfrigéré. L’équipage du navire, composé de quatre Nigérians, deux Maliens et deux Camerounais, est actuellement en détention. S’exprimant sur la saisie, le porte-parole de l’administration générale chinoise des douanes, Li Wu, a déclaré qu’un nombre croissant de groupes armés en Afrique utilisent le trafic d’organes pour se financer, ce qui rend ces saisies prévisibles. « Ces organes sont des produits courants aujourd’hui, mais ils ont certainement été prélevés dans des conditions insalubres ou contaminés. Nous ne pouvons donc pas permettre leur vente sur le marché chinois. » Selon M. Li, les organes ont été expédiés de Lagos, au Nigeria, mais il est possible qu’ils n’aient fait que transiter par ce pays et qu’ils puissent provenir d’ailleurs en Afrique. « Nous savons que les pénis provenant de Libye et du Soudan sont vendus à un prix plus élevé que ceux provenant d’autres zones de guerre africaines, mais nous ne pouvons pas déterminer leur origine avant la fin de l’enquête. » Décrivant la valeur de l’organe comme étant aussi élevée que celle des drogues illégales, il a déclaré que les pénis sont vendus à environ 160 000 dollars chacun sur le marché noir. Afrik Mag', '#organ_trafficking China: more than 7,000 penises seized by customs from Nigeria A total of 7,221 penises of African origin were seized by Chinese customs. It would be the largest seizure of human organs in history, reports hararelive. The organs, which were hidden in a refrigerated container, were seized when the ship docked in the port of Shanghai, following information provided by an anonymous informant. The organs were packed in 36 cartons labeled "plantain bananas" inside the refrigerated container. The ship\'s crew, consisting of four Nigerians, two Malians and two Cameroonians, is currently in detention. Speaking on the seizure, Chinese General Administration of Customs spokesman Li Wu said a growing number of armed groups in Africa are using organ trafficking to fund themselves, making these seizures predictable. “These organs are common products today, but they were certainly removed in unsanitary conditions or contaminated. We therefore cannot allow their sale in the Chinese market. » According to Mr. Li, the organs were shipped from Lagos, Nigeria, but it is possible that they were only in transit through that country and could have come from elsewhere in Africa. “We know that penises from Libya and Sudan are sold at a higher price than those from other African war zones, but we cannot determine their origin until the investigation is complete. » Describing the value of the organ as being as high as that of illegal drugs, he said the penises are sold for around $160,000 each on the black market. Afrik Mag', [('fra', 1.0)])

column5: ('Istri Tusuk Suami Usai Lihat Fotonya dengan Wanita Lain, Ternyata Perempuan Itu Dirinya Sendiri . column5: ('* Atención ¡¡¡¡Cuídate !!!!! * No dejar que te tomen la temperatura en la frente ... si quieres que lo hagan en la muñeca o brazo. Parece inofensivo, pero no lo es en absoluto. Traducción de mensaje importante de una enfermera australiana: "Estoy muy preocupado. Empecé a implementar los nuevos protocolos vigentes. Una de mis nuevas tareas es medir y registrar la temperatura de cada persona. Apunto al centro de su frente con mi termómetro, aprieto el gatillo, espero por el pitido y registrar la temperatura. ¡Siempre me disculpo con la persona antes de continuar! Después de hacer esto una docena o más de veces, de repente me di cuenta: ¿Nos estamos insensibilizando al dirigir esto a la cabeza y también causando posibles problemas de salud al apuntar un rayo infrarrojo a la glándula pineal? Luego comencé a medir la temperatura en la muñeca, que resultó ser más precisa, ya que la frente está más fría que la muñeca y los resultados difieren en más de un grado en algunos casos. Fui a un centro comercial y la gente hizo fila para tomarse la temperatura con un empleado que, obviamente no era médico y no estaba debidamente instruido sobre cómo realizar este procedimiento correctamente. Muchos se sorprendieron cuando llegó mi turno y tomé el arma que apuntaba a mi frente y la redirigí a mi puño. Hablé en voz baja pero con firmeza y le dije al empleado que nunca se debe apuntar un termómetro infrarrojo a la frente de alguien, especialmente de bebés y niños pequeños. Además, requiere conocimientos básicos de cómo leer correctamente la temperatura de alguien, es decir, colocar un termómetro en la muñeca o el codo es mucho más preciso y mucho menos dañino. Fue muy perturbador para mí ver a los niños acostumbrarse a ver un objeto con forma de arma apuntando a su frente y sin ninguna reacción negativa de los adultos como si esto fuera normal y aceptable. Como profesional médico, me niego a apuntar directamente a la glándula pineal, que se encuentra directamente en el centro de la frente, con un rayo infrarrojo. Sin embargo, la mayoría de la gente acepta pasar por esto varias veces al día. Nuestras glándulas pineales deben protegerse, ya que es crucial para nuestra salud ahora y en el futuro. _Glándula pineal_ La glándula pineal es una pequeña glándula del sistema endocrino en forma de piña. Estructura del diencéfalo del cerebro, la glándula pineal produce la hormona melatonina. La melatonina influye en el desarrollo sexual y los ciclos de sueño y vigilia. La glándula pineal está compuesta por células llamadas pinealocitos y células del sistema nervioso llamadas células gliales. La glándula pineal conecta el sistema endocrino con el sistema nervioso ya que convierte las señales nerviosas del sistema simpático del sistema nervioso periférico en señales hormonales. Con el tiempo, la acumulación de depósitos de calcio en la pineal puede provocar calcificaciones en los ancianos. _Funciones_ La glándula pineal está involucrada en varias funciones del cuerpo, que incluyen: •Secreción de la hormona melatonina. •Regulación de funciones endocrinas. •Conversión de señales del sistema nervioso en señales endocrinas. •Provoca somnolencia. •Influye en el desarrollo sexual. •Influye en la función del sistema inmunológico. •Actividad antioxidante. Pregúntese: ¿es prudente colocar un láser infrarrojo en la glándula pineal de alguien? [URL]', '* Attention Take care of yourself!!!!! * Don\'t let them take your temperature on your forehead... if you want them to do it on your wrist or arm. It seems harmless, but it is not at all. Translation of important message from an Australian nurse: "I am very worried. I started to implement the new protocols in force. One of my new tasks is to measure and record the temperature of each person. I point my thermometer at the center of his forehead, pull the trigger, wait for the beep and record the temperature. I always apologize to the person before continuing! After doing this a dozen or more times, I suddenly realized: Are we desensitizing ourselves by aiming this at the head and also causing possible health problems by aiming an infrared beam at the pineal gland? Then I started measuring the temperature at the wrist, which turned out to be more accurate, since the forehead is cooler than the wrist and the results differ by more than a degree in some cases. I went to a mall and people lined up to have their temperatures taken by an employee who was obviously not a doctor and was not properly instructed on how to perform this procedure correctly. Many were shocked when it was my turn and I took the gun pointed at my forehead and redirected it to my fist. I spoke quietly but firmly and told the clerk that an infrared thermometer should never be pointed at someone\'s forehead, especially infants and young children. Also, it requires basic knowledge of how to correctly read someone\'s temperature, meaning placing a thermometer on your wrist or elbow is much more accurate and much less harmful. It was very disturbing for me to see children get used to seeing a weapon shaped object pointed at their forehead and without any negative reaction from adults as if this was normal and acceptable. As a medical professional, I refuse to target the pineal gland, which is located directly in the center of the forehead, with an infrared beam. However, most people agree to go through this several times a day. Our pineal glands need to be protected as it is crucial to our health now and in the future. _Pineal gland_ The pineal gland is a small pineapple-shaped gland of the endocrine system. Structure of the diencephalon of the brain, the pineal gland produces the hormone melatonin. Melatonin influences sexual development and sleep-wake cycles. The pineal gland is made up of cells called pinealocytes and nervous system cells called glial cells. The pineal gland connects the endocrine system with the nervous system as it converts nerve signals from the sympathetic system of the peripheral nervous system into hormonal signals. Over time, the buildup of calcium deposits in the pineal can lead to calcifications in the elderly. _Functions_ The pineal gland is involved in various body functions, including: • Secretion of the hormone melatonin. •Regulation of endocrine functions. • Conversion of signals from the nervous system into endocrine signals. •Causes drowsiness. • Influences sexual development. •Influences the function of the immune system. • Antioxidant activity. Ask yourself: is it wise to put an infrared laser into someone\'s pineal gland? [URL]', [('spa', 1.0)])

column5: ('Por que os infartos 💔 ocorrem com mais frequência no banheiro As pessoas não devem começar molhando cabeça a cabeça e os cabelos durante o banho porque essa é uma sequência inversa. Ao fazer essa sequência incorreta, o sangue aumenta sua velocidade para chegar à cabeça mais rapidamente para compensar a diferença de temperatura que pode eventualmente causar rompimento de vasos, capilares, artérias e conseqüentemente um infarto ou quedas. A maneira correta de iniciar o banho é molhar os pés, as pernas gradativamente até os ombros e por último a cabeça. The government is now referring to our Canada Pension checks as a "Federal Benefit Payment." This isn\'t a benefit. It is our money paid out of our earned income! Not only did we all contribute to our pension but our employers did too. It totalled 15% of our income before taxes. If you averaged $30K per year over your working life, that\'s close to $180,000 invested in pension. If you calculate the future value of your monthly investment in a pension ($375/month, including both you and your employers contributions) at a meagre 1% interest rate compounded monthly, after 40 years of working you\'d have more than $1.3+ million dollars saved! column5: ('APROBARON HOY EL DERECHO ABSOLUTO A LA LEGÍTIMA DEFENSA SIN SER PROCESADOS PENALMENTE Aprueba Congreso la legítima defensa La reforma al Código Penal permite que ante la intromisión de intrusos el morador pueda defenderse sin ser procesado penalmente Quedó aprobada la figura de la legítima defensa en la reforma al Código Penal, lo cual permitirá que ante la intromisión de algún intruso a la vivienda (ladrón, delincuente, o no) que atente contra la integridad física o bienes patrimoniales, el morador podrá defenderse sin ser procesado penalmente. La propuesta fue votada por unanimidad, y permitirá que en el caso de algún asalto o robo con violencia, la víctima podrá golpear, herir, incluso matar al delincuente y estará amparado por la Ley. La diputada, Libia Dennise García Muñoz Ledo, integrante de la comisión, señaló que de acuerdo a la aprobación, quien se encuentre en su domicilio podrá repeler la agresión. “Cuando un intruso llegue a una casa habitación, quien esté en la casa pueda repeler esa agresión, de cualquier manera bajo cualquier circunstancia y utilizando los mecanismos o los elementos que tenga a la mano y de ninguna manera puede ser imputado penalmente”. García Muñoz Ledo aclaró que la iniciativa aprobada solamente garantiza la legítima defensa en viviendas y no en negocios o automóviles propiedad de la víctima, aunque se prevé que en un futuro se pueda aplicar a los negocios y vehículos. “La figura aplica solamente para casas habitación, es únicamente el domicilio donde habitamos pero incluye todo a la redonda, es decir nuestro patio, nuestro jardín, azotea, bardas, todo lo que es el contexto de la casa habitación”, señaló. TAMBIÉN VA PARA POLICÍAS Aquellos policías que entran a los domicilios aprovechándose del uniforme y cometan abuso de autoridad y allanen domicilios para robar, no quedan exentos de la Ley, ya que se podrá obrar de igual forma. “La gran ventaja de esta reforma es que cuando ingresen a tu domicilio con la finalidad de agredirte, se podrá utilizar cualquier mecanismo de defensa, así sea un supuesto policía que entre a robar o agredirte”. ÉSTO SÍ ES BUENO QUE LO COMPARTAS, PRINCIPALMENTE CON TUS FAMILIARES Y AMIGOS, PARA QUE NO SEAN ENGAÑADOS EN UN CASO DE ÉSTOS, TODOS UNIDOS COMPARTAMOS ESTE IMPORTANTE MENSAJE, POR FAVOR. Por ello el objeto de esta iniciativa es fortalecer la figura de la legítima defensa en el Código Penal Federal, con un enfoque pro víctima [URL]', 'TODAY APPROVED THE ABSOLUTE RIGHT TO SELF-DEFENSE WITHOUT BEING CRIMINALLY PROSECUTED Congress approves legitimate defense The reform to the Penal Code allows the inhabitant to defend himself against the interference of intruders without being criminally prosecuted The figure of legitimate defense was approved in the reform of the Penal Code, which will allow that in the event of the intrusion of an intruder into the home (thief, criminal, or not) who threatens physical integrity or patrimonial assets, the inhabitant will be able to defend himself without being criminally prosecuted. The proposal was voted unanimously, and will allow that in the case of an assault or robbery with violence, the victim will be able to hit, injure, even kill the offender and will be protected by the Law. The deputy, Libia Dennise García Muñoz Ledo, a member of the commission, pointed out that according to the approval, whoever is at her home will be able to repel the aggression. "When an intruder arrives at a dwelling house, whoever is in the house can repel that aggression, in any way under any circumstance and using the mechanisms or elements that are at hand and in no way can he be criminally charged." García Muñoz Ledo clarified that the approved initiative only guarantees legitimate defense in homes and not in businesses or automobiles owned by the victim, although it is expected that in the future it can be applied to businesses and vehicles. "The figure applies only to houses, it is only the address where we live but it includes everything around, that is, our patio, our garden, roof terrace, fences, everything that is the context of the house," he said. IT ALSO GOES FOR POLICE Those police officers who enter homes taking advantage of the uniform and commit abuse of authority and raid homes to steal, are not exempt from the Law, since they can act in the same way. “The great advantage of this reform is that when they enter your home in order to attack you, you can use any defense mechanism, even if it is a supposed police officer who comes in to rob or attack you.” IT IS GOOD THAT YOU SHARE IT, MAINLY WITH YOUR FAMILY AND FRIENDS, SO THAT THEY ARE NOT DECEIVED IN ONE OF THESE CASE, ALL OF US SHARE THIS IMPORTANT MESSAGE, PLEASE. Therefore, the purpose of this initiative is to strengthen the figure of legitimate defense in the Federal Penal Code, with a pro-victim approach. [URL]', [('spa', 1.0)])

column5: ('NON à la loi Blanquer !!. Parents, collègues, c\'est à diffuser ! Actuellement, la loi Blanquer (ou loi pour l\'école de la confiance) est en train d\'être votée en douce, dans l\'indifférence la plus totale. Cette loi est dangereuse pour l\'avenir de vos enfants !! Peut-être en avez-vous entendu parler aux infos ! Cependant, pour les médias, la loi Blanquer se résume à la scolarité dès 3 ans, au drapeau français dans les classes et au faux débat « parent 1/parent 2 ». Mais la loi Blanquer ce n\'est malheureusement pas que ça ! La loi Blanquer, c\'est surtout la fusion des écoles maternelles, élémentaires et des collèges. L\'objectif (comme dans toutes les fusions) est la fermeture massive de classes (voire d\'écoles dans les milieux ruraux) avec pour conséquence une hausse importante des effectifs (30/35 élèves ?) et la suppression des postes de directeur. Les écoles seront ainsi gérées par les chefs d\'établissement des collèges, ou leur adjoint, des personnes qui ne seront pas en classe et qui ne connaîtront pas la réalité du terrain ainsi que la spécificité de nos élèves, de vos enfants, puisqu\'ils ne seront pas sur place et qu\'ils auront des centaines d\'enfants à « suivre ». La loi Blanquer, c\'est aussi la fin des écoles de secteur : s\'il n\'y a plus de place pour accueillir votre enfant dans l\'école près de chez vous, il n\'y aura pas d\'ouverture de classe, votre enfant sera envoyé dans une autre école, que vous ne pourrez pas choisir ! Vous, qui avez choisi de vivre dans ce petit coin tranquille avec sa petite école tranquille, vous devrez peut être scolariser votre enfant dans l\'école à 20 min de chez vous, sans aucun recours ! La loi Blanquer , c\'est aussi la possibilité d\'embaucher de plus en plus de contractuels sous payés, sans exigence de diplôme et sans formation, pour enseigner à vos enfants, plutôt que d\'ouvrir des postes au concours. La loi Blanquer, c\'est l\'inclusion des enfants handicapés, sans assurer qu\'il y ait des moyens (personnels, formation) pour les accueillir dans de bonnes conditions. La loi Blanquer, c\'est tant d\'autres points qui mettent en danger l\'école, de part sa non-indépendance vis à vis du ministère (commission, observatoire, études diverses dirigés par des membres choisis par le gouvernement). La loi Blanquer, c\'est gérer les écoles comme on gère les entreprises, en ne pensant qu\'au chiffre au lieu de penser à l\'humain, et ici, aux enfants ! Parallèlement, les réformes des lycées et du bac creusent davantage les inégalités. Seuls les enfants issus de familles favorisées pourront réellement choisir leur filière. Les autres seront les grands sacrifiés... Enfin, la loi Blanquer, qui s\'intitule « école de la confiance », musèle la parole des enseignants. Le tout 1er article (c\'est révélateur!) impose aux enseignants de ne pas critiquer l\'institution (l\'éducation nationale) sous peine d\'être en faute professionnelle. Ainsi, dans quelque temps, je pourrai être renvoyé pour avoir posté ce message. Je n\'aurai pas le droit de dire que vos enfants sont en danger, physique d\'abord, parce que les classes ne sont pas adaptées pour accueillir plus de 30 enfants. Mais aussi en danger intellectuel, parce que je ne pourrai pas enseigner dans de bonnes conditions. Je devrai mentir aux parents, pour qu\'ils aient confiance en l\'école... Aujourd\'hui l\'état est en train de tuer mon métier, mais il est surtout en train de détruire tout le système éducatif et l\'avenir de nos enfants. J\'alerte donc tous les enseignants de mon entourage mais aussi les parents. Il est primordial d\'informer autour de vous, dans les écoles de vos enfants (beaucoup d\'enseignants ne sont pas au courant !), dans les associations de parents d\'élèves… " A diffuser, merci. [Texte reçu d\'un enseignant] En ce jour de la journée des ATSEM, autant diffuser un texte qui essaye de défendre l\'école Française ! Évidement celle-ci est imparfaite et on peut tous lui trouver des défauts mais ce n\'est rien en comparaison de ce qui se trame ! Soutien aux enseignant(e)s ! Soutien aux directeurs/trices ! Soutien aux ATSEM ! Soutien aux AVS ! La Bise Papa Chouch', 'NO to the Blanquer law!!. Parents, colleagues, it\'s to be broadcast! Currently, the Blanquer law (or law for the school of trust) is being passed quietly, in the most total indifference. This law is dangerous for the future of your children!! Maybe you heard about it on the news! However, for the media, the Blanquer law boils down to schooling from the age of 3, the French flag in the classrooms and the false “parent 1/parent 2” debate. But the Blanquer law is unfortunately not just that! The Blanquer law is above all the merger of nursery schools, elementary schools and colleges. The objective (as in all mergers) is the massive closure of classes (even schools in rural areas) resulting in a significant increase in enrollment (30/35 students?) and the elimination of director positions. The schools will thus be managed by the heads of establishments of the colleges, or their deputy, people who will not be in class and who will not know the reality on the ground as well as the specificity of our pupils, of your children, since they will not be there and that they will have hundreds of children to "follow". The Blanquer law is also the end of sector schools: if there is no more room to welcome your child in the school near you, there will be no class opening, your child will be sent to another school, which you will not be able to choose! You, who have chosen to live in this quiet little corner with its quiet little school, you may have to send your child to school 20 minutes from your home, without any recourse! The Blanquer law is also the possibility of hiring more and more underpaid contract workers, without the requirement of a diploma and without training, to teach your children, rather than opening positions in the competition. The Blanquer law is the inclusion of disabled children, without ensuring that there are means (staff, training) to accommodate them in good conditions. The Blanquer law is so many other points that endanger the school, due to its non-independence from the ministry (commission, observatory, various studies led by members chosen by the government). The Blanquer law is to manage schools as we manage companies, thinking only of the number instead of thinking of the human, and here, of the children! At the same time, the reforms of high schools and the baccalaureate further widen inequalities. Only children from privileged families will really be able to choose their course. The others will be the great sacrificed... Finally, the Blanquer law, which is called “school of trust”, muzzles the words of teachers. The very first article (it\'s revealing!) requires teachers not to criticize the institution (national education) under penalty of being in professional misconduct. So, in some time, I may be fired for posting this message. I will not have the right to say that your children are in danger, physical first, because the classes are not adapted to accommodate more than 30 children. But also in intellectual danger, because I will not be able to teach in good conditions. I will have to lie to the parents, so that they have confidence in the school... Today the state is killing my job, but above all it is destroying the entire education system and the future of our children. I therefore alert all the teachers around me but also the parents. It is essential to inform those around you, in your children\'s schools (many teachers are not aware!), in parents\' associations..." To distribute, thank you. [Text received from a teacher] On this day of ATSEM day, might as well spread a text that tries to defend the French school! Obviously this one is imperfect and we can all find faults with it, but that\'s nothing compared to what\'s going on! Support for teachers! Support for directors! Support for ATSEM! Support for AVS! Kiss Daddy Chouch', [('fra', 1.0)])

column5: ('Esta imagen resume claramente por que el estado español debería volver a su huso horario natural, el de Greenwich o GMT, cómo Reino Unido o Portugal, y no continuar con el de Berlín. En 1884, España fijó su hora legal en el huso horario que geográficamente le corresponde: el meridiano 0. Sin embargo, en 1942, en plena II Guerra Mundial, España adoptó el horario centroeuropeo cómo gesto de gracia de Franco hacia la Alemania nazi. Reino Unido y Portugal también cambiaron su horario. Sin embargo, al acabar la guerra, éstos volvieron al huso europeo occidental, pero el estado español continúa desde 1942, inexplicablemente, en un huso que no le corresponde por su posición geográfica y solar. Según un informe de la Comisión de Igualdad del Congreso, regresar al horario de Greenwich-GMT (inspirado en el ciclo solar diurno), tendría un efecto favorable en la conciliación familiar, laboral y personal de todas las personas.', "This image clearly summarizes why the Spanish state should return to its natural time zone, Greenwich or GMT, like the United Kingdom or Portugal, and not continue with Berlin. In 1884, Spain set its legal time in the time zone that corresponds geographically: the 0 meridian. However, in 1942, in the midst of World War II, Spain adopted Central European time as a gesture of grace by Franco towards Nazi Germany. The United Kingdom and Portugal also changed their schedule. However, at the end of the war, they returned to the western European zone, but the Spanish state continues since 1942, inexplicably, in a zone that does not correspond to it due to its geographical and solar position. According to a report by the Equality Commission of Congress, returning to Greenwich-GMT time (inspired by the diurnal solar cycle), would have a favorable effect on everyone's family, work and personal reconciliation.", [('spa', 1.0)])

column5: ("Le professeur Christian Cabrol nous a quitté il y a 2 jours dans le silence médiatique le plus total. Evidemment, il ne s'appelle pas Cyril Hanouna..ou Agnes Buzyn... Le Professeur Christian Cabrol a donné sa vie pour la chirurgie cardiaque réalisant la première greffe du coeur en Europe et la deuxième mondiale, la première greffe coeur poumon chez une enfant atteinte de mucoviscidose. Por tanto, no puede causar rechazos o alergias de ningún tipo. column5: ("La poire de l'angoisse! Cet appareil a été utilisé par les Esclavagistes Européens, sur les esclaves Noirs dans les années 1800. La poire, comme on l'appelait, était insérée dans le rectum des esclaves mâles s'ils refusaient le sexe avec leur maître. Une fois insérée, la clé serait tournée jusqu'à ce que la poire soit complètement ouverte et causait des dommages importants et même la mort en guise de punition. En ce qui concerne les femmes esclaves, si elles refusaient le sexe avec leur maître, la poire était insérée dans leur orifice sexuelle (provoquant une hémorragie massive et une infertilité). Pour les esclaves accusés de mensonge, la poire était placée dans la bouche et la clé était tournée jusqu'à ce que leur mâchoire soit cassée ! Sur Internet, il n'existe presque pas d'écrits concernant les tortures de l'esclavage. Veuillez donc partagez tout post que vous trouvez sur l'esclavage pour informer nos frères maintenus en ignorance. Nous devons apprendre, connaitre et défendre notre vraie histoire sinon le bourreau se fera toujours passer pour la victime et s'attribuera les éloges du chasseur. C'est la méconnaissance de notre histoire qui explique notre présent et déterminera notre future.. #LB", 'The pear of anguish! This device was used by European slavers on black slaves in the 1800s. The pear, as it was called, was inserted into the rectum of male slaves if they refused sex with their master. Once inserted, the key would be turned until the pear was fully opened and caused significant damage and even death as punishment. As for female slaves, if they refused sex with their master, the pear was inserted into their sexual orifice (causing massive bleeding and infertility). For slaves accused of lying, the pear was placed in their mouths and the key was turned until their jaws were broken! On the Internet, there are almost no writings about the tortures of slavery. So please share any posts you find on slavery to inform our brothers kept in the dark. We must learn, know and defend our true story otherwise the executioner will always pose as the victim and claim the praise of the hunter. It is the ignorance of our history that explains our present and will determine our future. #LB', [('fra', 1.0)])

column5: ('Istri Tusuk Suami Usai Lihat Fotonya dengan Wanita Lain, Ternyata Perempuan Itu Dirinya Sendiri . Seorang istri tusuk suaminya sendiri berkali-kali dengan pisau setelah cemburu melihat foto pasangannya itu dengan wanita lain. . Namun, ternyata perempuan yang ada di foto tersebut adalah sang istri sendiri beberapa tahun lalu. . Insiden tragis tapi aneh ini terjadi di Cajeme, Sonor, Meksiko. Sumber : [URL]', 'The wife stabs her husband after seeing his photo with another woman, it turns out that the woman is herself . However, it turns out that the woman in the photo is his own wife several years ago. . This tragic but strange incident occurred in Cajeme, Sonor, Mexico. The wife, identified as Leonora N, has been arrested by police. . As quoted from the Mirror, she was arrested after injuring her husband Juan N with a knife after finding a number of photos of her husband with a woman on his cellphone. . Leonora apparently thought that her husband had cheated on her. . Juan who then took the knife from his wife, then explained that it was a misunderstanding. . He said that the photo that was the source of the problem was the photo of the two of them. . He convinced his wife that it was an old photo that was digitized by him to put on his cell phone. . The police then arrived at the scene after being contacted by their neighbors who heard screams and sounds of fighting. . Local media reported that the wife has now been detained by the authorities, but charges against her have been put on hold. . This incident, only a month after the murder of the ex-husband of his ex-wife out of jealousy. . The ex-husband is reportedly jealous when he sees his ex-wife wearing an engagement ring, even though they just divorced in 2019. . Ser feliz é achar a força no perdão, esperança nas batalhas, segurança no palco do medo, amor na discórdia. Ser feliz não é só apreciar o sorriso, mas também refletir sobre a tristeza. Não é só celebrar os sucessos, mas aprender lições dos fracassos. Não é só sentir-se feliz com os aplausos, mas ser feliz no anonimato. Ser feliz é reconhecer que vale a pena viver a vida, apesar de todos os desafios, incompreensões, períodos de crise. Ser feliz não é uma fatalidade do destino, mas uma conquista para aqueles que conseguem viajar para dentro de si mesmo. Ser feliz é parar de sentir-se vítima dos problemas e se tornar autor da própria história. É atravessar desertos fora de si, mas conseguir achar um oásis no fundo da nossa alma. É agradecer a Deus por cada manhã, pelo milagre da vida. Ser feliz, não é ter medo dos próprios sentimentos. É saber falar de si. É ter coragem de ouvir um "não". É sentir-se seguro ao receber uma crítica, mesmo que injusta. É beijar os filhos, mimar os pais, viver momentos poéticos com os amigos, mesmo quando nos magoam. Ser feliz é deixar viver a criatura que vive em cada um de nós, livre, alegre e simples. É ter maturidade para poder dizer: "errei". É ter a coragem de dizer:"perdão". É ter a sensibilidade para dizer: "eu preciso de você". É ter a capacidade de dizer: "te amo". Que a tua vida se torne um jardim de oportunidades para ser feliz... Que nas suas primaveras seja amante da alegria. Que nos seus invernos seja amante da sabedoria. E que quando errar, recomece tudo do início. Pois somente assim será apaixonado pela vida. Descobrirá que ser feliz não é ter uma vida perfeita. Mas usar as lágrimas para irrigar a tolerância. Utilizar as perdas para treinar a paciência. Usar os erros para esculpir a serenidade. Utilizar a dor para lapidar o prazer. Utilizar os obstáculos para abrir janelas de inteligência. Nunca desista....Nunca renuncie às pessoas que lhes amam.Nunca renuncie à felicidade, pois a vida é um espetáculo incrível". Papa Francisco.', 'Watch the Pope\'s homily yesterday!!! Wonderful!! "You may have flaws, be anxious, and sometimes live irritated, but don\'t forget that your life is the greatest company in the world. Only you can prevent it from going into decline. Many appreciate you, admire you and love you. remember that being happy is not having a sky without storms, a road without accidents, work without fatigue, relationships without disappointments. Being happy is finding strength in forgiveness, hope in battles, security in the stage of fear, love in discord. It\'s not just appreciating the smile, but also reflecting on sadness. It\'s not just celebrating successes, but learning lessons from failures. It\'s not just feeling happy with applause, but being happy in anonymity. Being happy is recognizing that it\'s worth life is worth living, despite all the challenges, misunderstandings, periods of crisis. Being happy is not a fatality of fate, but an achievement for those who manage to travel within themselves. To be happy is to stop feeling like a victim of problems and become the author of his own story . It\'s crossing deserts outside of yourself, but managing to find an oasis in the depths of our soul. It is to thank God for each morning, for the miracle of life. Being happy is not being afraid of your own feelings. It\'s knowing how to talk about yourself. It\'s having the courage to hear a "no". It\'s feeling safe when receiving criticism, even if unfair. It\'s kissing the children, pampering the parents, living poetic moments with friends, even when they hurt us. To be happy is to let the creature that lives in each of us live, free, joyful and simple. It\'s having maturity to be able to say: "I was wrong". It\'s having the courage to say, "I\'m sorry". It\'s having the sensitivity to say: "I need you". It\'s having the ability to say, "I love you". May your life become a garden of opportunities to be happy... May your springtime be a lover of joy. May in your winters be a lover of wisdom. And that when you make a mistake, start over from the beginning. For only then will you be in love with life. You will discover that being happy is not having a perfect life. But using tears to irrigate tolerance. Use losses to train patience. Using mistakes to sculpt serenity. Using pain to cut pleasure. Use obstacles to open intelligence windows. Never give up....Never give up on the people who love you. Never give up on happiness, for life is an incredible spectacle." Pope Francis.', [('por', 1.0)])

column5: ('قاض يقبل يد متهم.. والسبب؟ أصر قاضٍ في إحدى المحاكم الاردنية في مدينة الزرقاء على تقبيل يد متهم، مَثُل أمامه للنظر بقضية "اعتداء"، تتمحور بأن المتهم الذي يعمل معلم مدرسة ضرب بالعصا أحد الطلبة، ما دفع ذوي الأخير لتقديم شكوى بحق المعلم، واضطره للمثول أمام هيئة المحكمة. وتفاجأ الحضور بفعل القاضي الذي أصر على تقبيل يد المتهم، ليكشف لاحقا بأن المتهم الذي يمثل أمامه هو معلمه القديم في المدرسة، ومربٍ فاضل وكبير في السن، في حين قرر القاضي بأن تكون قبلته على يد المتهم "المعلم" هي الحكم في القضية المنظورة. وفور مغادرة الحضور لقاعة المحكمة تداول نشطاء عبر مواقع التواصل الاجتماعي قصة القاضي مع معلمه المتهم، مشيدين بالأخلاق العالية التي تحلى بها القاضي وتقديره الكبير للمعلم الذي كان سببا في وصوله وترقيته في عمله وعلمه. وطالب معلقون، وزارة التربية والتعليم والجهات الحكومية المعنية بسن قوانين وأنظمة تحمي المعلم خلال قيامه بالعملية التعليمية، مستنكرين أن يمكث معلم مسن خرّج أجيالا خلف قضبان الاتهام بسبب ضرب طالب بعصا.', 'A judge kisses the hand of an accused... and the reason? A judge in a Jordanian court in the city of Zarqa insisted on kissing the hand of a defendant who appeared before him to consider a case of "assault", which revolves around that the accused, who works as a school teacher, beat one of the students with a stick, which prompted the latter\'s family to file a complaint against the teacher, forcing him to appear before the court. The audience was surprised by the judge’s action, who insisted on kissing the accused’s hand, to reveal later that the accused who appears before him is his old school teacher, and a virtuous and old educator. Whereas, the judge decided that his kiss on the hand of the accused "the teacher" should be the ruling in the case under consideration. As soon as the audience left the courtroom, activists circulated on social media the story of the judge with his accused teacher, praising the high morals of the judge and his great appreciation for the teacher, who was the reason for his arrival and promotion in his work and his knowledge. Commentators called on the Ministry of Education and the relevant government agencies to enact laws and regulations that protect the teacher during the educational process, denouncing the fact that an elderly teacher who has produced generations remain behind bars for hitting a student with a stick.', [('ara', 1.0)])

column5: ('A pandemia mais grave da história foi a gripe espanhola de 1918. Durou 2 anos, em 3 ondas de contaminação com 500 milhões de pessoas infectadas e totalizando 55 milhões de mortes. A maioria das mortes ocorreu durante a segunda onda de contaminação. A população tolerou tão mal as medidas de quarentena e de distanciamento social, que quando ocorreu a primeira saída pública liberada, a população começou a se alegrar nas ruas, abandonando todas as medidas de precauções aprendidas. Nas semanas seguintes, a segunda onda de contaminação chegou com milhões de morte. Portanto, não se empolguem quando for tudo liberado, mantenham calma e continuem tomando muito cuidado. Não vamos querer uma segunda onda de coronavírus.', "The most serious pandemic in history was the Spanish flu of 1918. It lasted 2 years, in 3 waves of contamination with 500 million people infected and a total of 55 million deaths. Most deaths occurred during the second wave of contamination. The population tolerated the quarantine and social distancing measures so poorly that when the first public outing took place, the population began to rejoice in the streets, abandoning all the precautionary measures learned. In the following weeks, the second wave of contamination arrived with millions of deaths. So don't get carried away when everything is released, stay calm and continue to be very careful. We don't want a second wave of coronavirus.", [('por', 1.0)])

column5: ('เบกกิ้งโซดา ช่วยทำให้ออกกำลังกายได้อึดขึ้น! ทนขึ้น! 💪 ความรู้สึกเหนื่อยล้าจากการออกกำลังกายนั้นส่วนนึงมาจากการที่ระหว่างการออกกำลังกายนั้นจะทำให้ร่างกายมีการเปลี่ยนสภาวะให้มีความเป็นกรดมากขึ้น ทำให้มีแนวคิดในการรักษาสมดุลกรดด่างในร่างกายขึ้นมา เพราะถ้าหากลดการเปลี่ยนสภาวะให้มีความเป็นกรดได้ก็จะทำให้รู้สึกเหนื่อยล้าลดลงและออกกำลังกายได้มากขึ้น ตัวนึงที่ถูกนำมาศึกษาคือโซเดียมไบคาร์บอเนตหรือเบกกิ้งโซดาที่ใช้ในการทำขนมและประกอบอาหารนั่นเอง ได้ผลจริงมั้ย? ในหลายๆ การศึกษาวิจัยพบว่าได้ผลแตกต่างอย่างมีนัยยะสำคัญ โดยพบว่า รู้สึกเหนื่อยน้อยลง (Rated of Perceived Exertion) 7% ปริมาณที่ใช้ในการวิจัยที่พบว่าได้ผลจริงๆ คือ 0.3-0.4 g/ นน ตัว 1 kg นั่นคือถ้า นน ตัว 50 kg ต้องทานเบกกิ้งโซดา 15-20 g หมายเหตุ: บางงานก็ใช้ 0.3 g/ นน ตัว 1 kg แต่ไม่ได้ผลก็มีค่อนข้างมาก แสดงว่าปริมาณดังกล่าวอาจจะไม่มากพอที่จะทำให้เห็นผล สรุป 1.โซเดียมไบคาร์บอเนตหรือเบกกิ้งโซดาช่วยเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพการออกกำลังกายได้ แต่มีงานวิจัยจำนวนไม่น้อยที่ตั้งข้อสงสัยถึงประสิทธิภาพของเบกกิ้งโซดา 2.ขนาดที่ใช้ในการวิจัยคือ 3-0.4 g/ นน ตัว 1 kg 3.เบกกิ้งโซดามีโซเดียมราว 30% ถ้ากินตามโดสที่แนะนำจะได้รับโซเดียมในปริมาณที่มาก ถึงแม้เราไม่ต้องกลัวโซเดียมในเรื่องลดน้ำหนักแต่ในเชิงสุขภาพก็ไม่ควรได้รับมากเกินไป อ้างอิง 1.Krustrup P, Ermidis G, Mohr M. One that was studied was sodium bicarbonate, or baking soda, used in baking and cooking. Does it really work? In several studies, significant differences in results were found. Feeling less tired (Rated of Perceived Exertion) 7% The amount used in research that has been found to be effective is 0.3-0.4 g/weight per 1 kg body, that is, if a 50 kg body weight requires 15-20 g of baking soda. Note: Some works use 0.3 g/ weight, 1 kg body, but not quite effective. Shows that the amount may not be enough to see results. summarize 1. Sodium bicarbonate or baking soda can improve exercise performance. But there are a number of studies that question the effectiveness of baking soda. 2. While we shouldn't be afraid of sodium when it comes to weight loss, it shouldn't be too much for health reasons. refer 1.Krustrup P, Ermidis G, Mohr M. J Sports Sci. 2012;30(10):975-83. 3.Carr AJ, Slater GJ, Gore CJ, Dawson B, Burke LM. Reliability and effect of sodium bicarbonate: buffering and 2000-m rowing performance. Int J Sports Physiol Perform. 2012;7(2):152-60. credit: [URL]", [('tha', 1.0)])

column5: ('Bom dia! No Senegal, esta árvore baobá atingiu os 6000 anos. O que vocês me dizem? Originário da África, o baobá é uma das maiores e mais antigas árvores do mundo, chegando a alcançar, quando adulto, de 5 a 25 m de altura e de 7 a 11 m de diâmetro no tronco. Essa planta é milenar e pode viver até 6.000 anos. No meio científico, é conhecida como Adansonia Digitata, nome que recebeu em homenagem ao pesquisador francês Michel Adanson, o primeiro a relatar a existência desse tipo de árvore. Ao todo, existem oito espécies de Baobás: seis nativas de Madagascar, uma da Austrália e uma do Senegal. Também chamado de embondeiro, imbondeiro ou calabaceira, o baobá é a árvore nacional de Madagascar e o emblema nacional do Senegal, sendo nesse país considerada sagrada e utilizada como fonte de inspiração para lendas, poesias e ritos. De acordo com uma dessas antigas lendas, se um morto for enterrado dentro do tronco de um Baobá, sua alma continuará viva enquanto a planta existir. Baobá Presente na Literatura Essa árvore pode ser vista também na literatura, no livro “O Pequeno Príncipe”, escrito pelo francês Antoine de Saint-Exupéry. Acredita-se que, para incluir a planta na história, o escritor inspirou-se no baobá da Praça da República de Recife, quando passou por lá. Na obra, o protagonista temia os baobás, pois o crescimento excessivo dessas árvores poderia tomar todo o espaço do asteroide onde vivia. Principais Curiosidades Existem diversas curiosidades sobre essa planta. A mais marcante delas está relacionada ao seu extraordinário tronco, que tem formato encorpado na base e vai se estreitando como se fosse um cone, com grandes protuberâncias e galhos que permanecem sem folhas durante nove meses. Por isso, quando observada com atenção, a árvore parece ter sido plantada de cabeça para baixo. O tronco é oco e resistente ao fogo e, nos meses de chuva, serve de reservatório de água – algumas espécies possuem capacidade de armazenar até 120 mil litros. Por esse motivo, o baobá é conhecido como “árvore garrafa”. Também graças a essas peculiaridades, é comum encontrar pessoas que usem o tronco como moradia, santuários, bares, pontos de ônibus e até como prisões. Tudo nessas plantas pode ser aproveitado. Os frutos, chamados de mukua, são ricos em vitamina C, potássio e cálcio. Sua casca é utilizada na fabricação de cordas e tecido; as folhas têm propriedades medicinais e são aproveitadas como condimento; e de suas sementes pode-se extrair um óleo rico em vitaminas A e F. Outro fato curioso com relação à planta diz respeito à sua floração que, geralmente, ocorre durante uma única noite.', 'Good Morning! In Senegal, this baobab tree has reached 6000 years. What do you say? Originally from Africa, the baobab is one of the largest and oldest trees in the world, reaching, as an adult, 5 to 25 m in height and 7 to 11 m in trunk diameter. This plant is millenary and can live up to 6,000 years. In the scientific world, it is known as Adansonia Digitata, named after the French researcher Michel Adanson, the first to report the existence of this type of tree. In all, there are eight species of Baobabs: six native to Madagascar, one to Australia and one to Senegal. Also called baobab, baobab or calabash, the baobab is the national tree of Madagascar and the national emblem of Senegal, being considered sacred in this country and used as a source of inspiration for legends, poetry and rites. According to one of these ancient legends, if a dead person is buried inside the trunk of a Baobab tree, its soul will live on as long as the plant exists. Baobab Present in Literature This tree can also be seen in literature, in the book “The Little Prince”, written by the Frenchman Antoine de Saint-Exupéry. It is believed that, to include the plant in the story, the writer was inspired by the baobab tree in the Praça da República in Recife, when he passed by. In the work, the protagonist feared the baobabs, as the excessive growth of these trees could take up the entire space of the asteroid where he lived. Main Curiosities There are several interesting facts about this plant. The most striking of these is related to its extraordinary trunk, which has a full-bodied shape at the base and becomes narrower as if it were a cone, with large protuberances and branches that remain leafless for nine months. Therefore, when closely observed, the tree appears to have been planted upside down. The trunk is hollow and resistant to fire and, in the rainy months, it serves as a water reservoir – some species have the capacity to store up to 120 thousand liters. For this reason, the baobab is known as the “bottle tree”. Also thanks to these peculiarities, it is common to find people who use the trunk as housing, sanctuaries, bars, bus stops and even as prisons. Everything in these plants can be used. The fruits, called mukua, are rich in vitamin C, potassium and calcium. Its bark is used in the manufacture of ropes and fabric; the leaves have medicinal properties and are used as a condiment; and from its seeds an oil rich in vitamins A and F can be extracted. Another curious fact about the plant concerns its flowering, which generally occurs during a single night.', [('por', 1.0)])

column5: ('Baru-baru ini, seorang ibu muda dari Meksiko mengaku mengalami efek samping aneh akibat infeksi COVID-19. Wanita bernama Anna Cortez itu menyebut ASI-nya berubah warna menjadi hijau neon. Tak cuma Anna, pengalaman serupa juga pernah dibagikan seorang ibu dari dua anak dari AS. Lewat unggahan di akun Instagram pribadinya pada tahun 2021 silam, Ashmiry membagikan foto ASI perah sebelum dan sesudah terinfeksi COVID-19. Di mana ASI yang dihasilkannya saat terinfeksi COVID-19 tampak berwarna kehijauan. "Perubahan warna mengindikasikan bahwa tubuh saya menghasilkan persis apa yang Rubi (anaknya) butuhkan! Antibodi, ekstra lemak dan kebaikan murni," tulisnya Ashmiry kala itu. Melansir dari Daily Star, seorang ahli mengungkap perubahan warna ASI yang dialami Anna dan Ashmiry terjadi akibat respon tubuh yang memicu antibodi. Antibodi dalam tubuh muncul untuk melawan virus corona dan melindungi si bayi. Jika ibu mengalami perubahan warna ASI, artinya tubuh memang membutuhkan hal itu sebagai antibodi untuk melawan penyakit. "Dokter anak telah memberi tahu saya harus tetap menyusui anak ketika dinyatakan positif virus corona, karena langkah itu yang terbaik untuk kesehatannya. ASI akan memberikan semua nutrisi yang dibutuhkan bayi. Jika dia sakit, asupan ASI ini akan membantu melawannya," ujarnya. Sementara itu, menurut peneliti ASI di Imperial College London sekaligus pendiri Human Milk Foundation, Dr Natalie Shenker mengatakan bahwa wanita yang terinfeksi virus corona memang menghasilkan antibodi COVID-19 di dalam ASI. "Antibodi yang ada di dalam ASI ini adalah jenis antibodi yang bisa membunuh virus," jelasnya. Natalie turut menegaskan bahwa virus corona tidak akan masuk ke dalam ASI. The woman named Anna Cortez said her breast milk had turned neon green. Not only Anna, a similar experience has also been shared by a mother of two children from the US. Through an upload on his personal Instagram account in 2021 ago, Ashmiry shared photos of expressed breast milk before and after being infected with COVID-19. Where the milk it produces when infected with COVID-19 looks greenish. "The change in color indicates that my body produces exactly what Rubi (kids) needs! Antibodies, extra fat and pure goodness," Ashmiry wrote at the time. Launching from the Daily Star, an expert revealed that Anna and Ashmiry\'s breast milk color changes occurred due to the body\'s response that triggers antibodies. Antibodies in the body appear to fight the corona virus and protect the baby. If the mother experiences a change in the color of her breast milk, it means that the body does need it as an antibody to fight disease. "The pediatrician has told me that I should continue to breastfeed my child when I test positive for the coronavirus, because it\'s the best for her health. Breast milk will provide all the nutrients the baby needs. If she is sick, this breast milk intake will help fight it," she said. Meanwhile, according to breast milk researcher at Imperial College London and founder of the Human Milk Foundation, Dr Natalie Shenker said that women infected with the corona virus did produce COVID-19 antibodies in breast milk. "The antibodies in breast milk are the type of antibodies that can kill viruses," he explained. Natalie also emphasized that the corona virus would not pass into breast milk. This has been proven by research that there is no Corona virus that enters breast milk and the breastfeeding process will not transmit the virus.', [('msa', 1.0)])

column5: ('SE ACERCA UN ASTEROIDE: ¿PUEDE PASAR LO DE "NO MIRES ARRIBA"? Será el próximo 18 de enero, informa el Centro de estudios de objetos cercanos a la Tierra de la NASA. Although it is a "potentially dangerous" event, experts say it is not a threat to the human race. It will pass close to Earth again in 2105. In any case, specialists have long studied the possibility that this really happens. For this reason, in November 2021, NASA launched the DART spacecraft, the world\'s first mission that will seek to impact an asteroid in space and thus test planetary defense techniques. #Asteroid #NASA #Space #Don\'tLookUp', [('spa', 1.0)])

column3: [("Geert Vanden Bossche, DMV, PhD, independent virologist and vaccine expert, formerly employed at GAVI and The Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. To all authorities, scientists and experts around the world, to whom this concerns: the entire world population. I am all but an antivaxxer. As a scientist I do not usually appeal to any platform of this kind to make a stand on vaccine-related topics. As a dedicated virologist and vaccine expert I only make an exception when health authorities allow vaccines to be administered in ways that threaten public health, most certainly when scientific evidence is being ignored. The present extremely critical situation forces me to spread this emergency call. As the unprecedented extent of human intervention in the Covid-19- pandemic is now at risk of resulting in a global catastrophe without equal, this call cannot sound loudly and strongly enough. As stated, I am not against vaccination. On the contrary, I can assure you that each of the current vaccines have been designed, developed and manufactured by brilliant and competent scientists. However, this type of prophylactic vaccines are completely inappropriate, and even highly dangerous, when used in mass vaccination campaigns during a viral pandemic. Vaccinologists, scientists and clinicians are blinded by the positive short-term effects in individual patients, but don't seem to bother about the disastrous consequences for global health. Unless I am scientifically proven wrong, it is difficult to understand how current human interventions will prevent circulating variants from turning into a wild monster. Racing against the clock, I am completing my scientific manuscript, the publication of which is, unfortunately, likely to come too late given the ever increasing threat from rapidly spreading, highly infectious variants. This is why I decided to already post a summary of my findings as well as my keynote speech at the recent Vaccine Summit in Ohio on LinkedIn. Last Monday, I provided international health organizations, including the WHO, with my analysis of the current pandemic as based on scientifically informed insights in the immune biology of Covid-19. Given the level of emergency, I urged them to consider my concerns and to initiate a debate on the detrimental consequences of further 'viral immune escape'. For those who are no experts in this field, I am attaching below a more accessible and comprehensible version of the science behind this insidious phenomenon. While there is no time to spare, I have not received any feedback thus far. Experts and politicians have remained silent while obviously still eager to talk about relaxing infection prevention rules and 'springtime freedom'. My statements are based on nothing else but science. They shall only be contradicted by science. While one can barely make any incorrect scientific statements without being by peers, it seems like the elite of scientists who are currently advising our world leaders prefer to stay silent. Sufficient scientific evidence has been brought to the table. Unfortunately, it remains untouched by those who have the power to act. How long can one ignore the problem when there is at present massive evidence that viral immune escape is now threatening humanity? We can hardly say we didn't know - or were not warned. In this agonizing letter I put all of my reputation and credibility at stake. I expect from you, guardians of mankind, at least the same. It is of utmost urgency. Do open the debate. By all means: turn the tide!
